_meta.note: G7 counter-nanite armoured suits (G7_REFERENCE 13.9c-20, 13.9c-6, 13.9c-13; 6.3-6.8). One-man powered armour built ONLY at the facility's Armory + Suit Bay (cn_armory, a facility part on the armory zone, exo_garage: the G6 Exo rules hold: Stage gate, suit = one vehicle element, the gunner inside ejects as a G5 Wounded when the suit is destroyed and the side has medical capability, re-suit at the suit bay for resuit_cost_mult). Four roles, Human A and Human B: Bastion = heavy-gun line suit (12.7 mm rotary on the right arm, belt-fed from the back cassette; suppression, escort, screens the APCs), Breaker = anti-armour / anti-walker suit (twin-cell tandem top-attack missile pod on the right shoulder; hunts walkers and vehicles with the pincer), Aegis = counter-air / counter-drone suit (30 mm proximity-fuzed cannon on the right arm, folding search radar on the back; drones, gunships, low air), Purifier = anti-nanite suit (the facility's nanite-disruptor projector on a forearm mount, capacitor bank on the back; swarms, creep growths, Machine infantry at short range). Stats balanced against the G6 exo suits (a_exo_*: hp 600-700, speed 2.2, pop 3) and the CN operators: heavier, slower, sealed, dearer, slower to build. Every number PROVISIONAL.

g7_cns_aegis.name: Aegis Suit
g7_cns_aegis._role: counter-air / counter-drone: 30 mm proximity-fuzed cannon, folding search radar on the back

g7_cns_purifier.name: Purifier Suit
g7_cns_purifier._role: anti-nanite: forearm nanite-disruptor projector, capacitor bank on the back; swarms and Machine infantry at short range

g7_cns_gunner.name: Suit Gunner
g7_cns_gunner._role: the one gunner who drives and fights a CN suit; ejects through the rear hatch when it is destroyed (not trainable on its own)

g7_b_cns_gunner.name: Suit Gunner
g7_b_cns_gunner._role: Human B suit gunner (not trainable on its own)

g7_cns_hmg._note: Bastion: 12.7 mm three-barrel rotary, belt feed from the back cassette. DPS ~ G6 rifle suit; reaches helicopters / drones, not jets. PROVISIONAL.

g7_cns_atgm._note: Breaker: tandem top-attack missile (2-cell pod, reloaded from the back magazine). top_attack class: x1.6 vs heavy. cn_stagger = walker stagger per hit for Apc7.hit_heavy once a combat hook routes it (CR to CNSIM7). PROVISIONAL.

g7_cns_cuas._note: Aegis: 30 mm proximity-fuzed cannon cued by the back radar; x3 vs drones; reaches all air. PROVISIONAL.

g7_cns_disruptor._note: Purifier: nanite-disruptor projector (the facility's disruptor round family): short range, small splash, x2 vs drones; strong vs swarms of light Machine units. PROVISIONAL.

g7_cns_pdw._note: the suit gunner's personal defence weapon (after ejecting). PROVISIONAL.

cn_armory.name: Suit Foundry
cn_armory._note: EXO7 (13.9c-20, 13.9c-6): the facility's armory + suit bay as a real part on the armory zone (zone art draws it; FACB7 art). The only building that builds the CN armoured suits (production.facility = cn_armory); a suit bay = an exo garage for the G6 Exo rules (can_produce gate, re-suit an ejected gunner at x0.5 cost). PROVISIONAL.
